shared_elements: rectangular panel with grid-like or glyph-like geometric filler
horizontal band or belt-like division across the surface
justification: Both present a tall vertical stack in shallow relief in which a rectilinear, grid-filled upper panel sits above paired oval eye-like forms and a prominent central disc, with a horizontal band dividing the lower zone — a fairly specific and comparable ordering of motifs. The biggest difference is format and finish: A is carved into an irregular, weathered light-coloured rock face where the design bleeds into natural fissures, while B is a discrete dark monolith with a defined outline, head and shoulders, giving a crisper, more sculptural whole.
